groups.why_chosen: Chains four representations of the same schedule (symbolic graph, formal constraints, solved graph, generated code) into one numbered pipeline so the same dependency structure visibly survives each transform.
groups.what_to_learn: Draw the same two-row dependency graph twice, logical-time then execution-time, and make the ILP's solution visible as a literal geometric skew (angle θ) between the two layouts; number the pipeline 1-4, flanked by the formal constraints and the emitted code.
